statement: Both refinements are frozen here, BEFORE anything is measured on the independent set. The independent set was spent in Phase 10.6, so every number measured on it after this point is POST-HOC (development) and optimistic, and is labelled so in the report.

improvement_A.name: no-DTC-match recognition
improvement_A.rule: mechanical evidence AND no electronic evidence -> no matching DTC
improvement_A.authored_from: general workshop complaint categories, not from the wording of any gold row
adjusted_during_development: a bare deposit word ('residue', 'crust') no longer declines on its own: it describes both a leak trace and combustion residue inside a DPF, and the latter IS a coded fault (found on TEST row t054)
a reported 'warning' of any kind now counts as electronic evidence even without the word 'lamp', because the ECU raised it (found on DEV row d017)

improvement_B.name: soft subsystem prior
improvement_B.weight_chosen_on: DEV (gold v2.2); the effect saturates at 0.5, and the smallest weight reaching the plateau was taken
improvement_B.mechanism: adds w/(RRF_K+1) to the fused score of records whose system the query's words point at - at most one RRF rank-1 vote. A soft boost inside fusion, never a filter.

no_regression_gate.DEV: in-scope 28/28, out-of-scope 6/6, groups 3/3 for all four configs
